answer: Attester bonds make every countersignature a fake key needs cost its signer. A key becomes established only after 5 distinct attesters each lock a 20 POA onyx bond behind it. Every bond is recorded in the shale ledger, and when an audit finds one shared controller, an island of fakes attesting each other forfeits every bond tied to it. With a 50% audit hit rate, 1,000 fakes x 5 bonds x 20 POA x 50% = 50,000 POA slashed. Attacker pays 50,000 POA.
